mode: Built-in image_gen.imagegen. One individual generation/edit call per cuisine. No fallback CLI.
intent: Isolated replacement cooking-room interiors only. Original ramen, stone arch/frame, vines, lamps, salon, spa, corridor and all other scene art remain available and unchanged.

packaging.operations: Resize generated source to 450×500; crop the floor-only bottom 50 pixels; encode a 450×450 WebP at quality 88, method 6. These are asset packaging operations only, not illustration changes.
packaging.runtimeTarget: 223×250 original scene coordinates, clipped to the original arched restaurant opening.

assets.finalPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: tightly cropped replacement interior texture for a tiny restaurant bay inside an existing painted hotel game scene. This is one isolated vertical rectangular interior panel, approximately 9:10 width:height, at least 900×1000 pixels.
Input image 1 is the existing approved hotel scene. EDIT ONLY THE LEFTMOST RAMEN RESTAURANT CONTENT: return a close crop of the new interior alone, corresponding exactly to the ORIGINAL restaurant opening x72..295, y74..324 in the 1200×700 reference. The other rooms and corridor are NOT part of the output. Do not return the original whole reference composition.
The outer stone arch, ivy, lanterns and corridor will be reused unchanged by the game and layered in front of this texture, so DO NOT paint a new arch, outer facade, border, foliage or outside hallway. Instead fill the ENTIRE output rectangle edge-to-edge with the plausible room interior behind that arch. No blank margin, no white background, no atlas grid, no decorative frame. The upper corners may simply continue the dark forest-green backsplash; game architecture will occlude them.
Preserve the original room's scale, viewpoint and design: straight-on frontal view, a little high so the viewer can see the counter top and floor; warm amber honey lighting; dark forest-green tiled or paneled back wall; beautiful polished golden honey-brown wood counter across the width; three compact green-cushioned stools with brass legs along the bottom; small bronze/copper kitchenware and cozy subtle shelves. Keep the counter front near the lower third and a short strip of original-looking golden tile floor at the bottom. No people.
Style: exactly the high-quality cozy detailed painterly storybook rendering in the supplied hotel, dimensional and beautifully lit, NOT flat vector, NOT cartoon outlines, NOT photo, NOT pixel art. Broad clear cooking silhouettes must remain immediately readable when the whole panel is shrunk to only 223×250 px in the game. Do not cram many tiny objects.
Primary replacement: earned sushi bar. A clearly recognizable sushi preparation counter: a generous wooden sushi serving boat with a row of salmon nigiri and large circular maki rolls with dark nori edges and white rice; behind it, a pale wooden cutting board, neat salmon fillet, bamboo rolling mat, small rice tub and simple ceramic bowls. One large generous sashimi/sushi presentation across the counter is the focal point. Back shelving has quiet ceramic crockery, NOT a pot-and-steam ramen scene.
Constraints: no flags, no national symbols, no text or lettering, no signage, no watermarks, no neon, no country caricatures. Output only this one isolated interior.
